test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

Roshni said to Rakesh, "Time and tide waits for none."

options.text: Roshni told Rakesh if time and tide waited for none.
Roshni told Rakesh that time and tide waits for none.
Roshni told Rakesh whether time and tide waited for none.
Roshni told Rakesh that time and tide waited for none.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is a universal truth, as "Time and tide wait for none" is a well-known proverb.
 
• When converting direct speech to indirect speech for universal truths or proverbs, the tense remains unchanged.
 
• The reporting verb "said to" changes to "told" in indirect speech.
 
• The correct sentence becomes: "Roshni told Rakes
